Goal: relaunch today with a message that converts one-person-company founders.

evidence.label: Launch conversion problem
evidence.text: The internal launch context states that the relaunch goal is to convert one-person-company founders and that the current signal is low signup conversion because visitors do not recognise themselves.

evidence.label: Partnership evaluation criteria
evidence.text:
Partnership evaluation criteria (internal):
1. Relevance: the target must serve SME / one-person-company buyers with a product the company can resell, refer or integrate.
2. Reliability: publicly verifiable operating history of at least 12 months, or a credible parent organisation.
3. Reachability: an identified business contact channel (public business email or partner form).
4. Risk posture: no unresolved public fraud/sanction signals; clear terms of service.
5. Economics: free tier, referral or partner programme preferred over paid-only access.

Launch page — revised messaging package (version 7; draft for review, not published)

Core message
Somebody is an AI manager for one-person-company founders and lean SMEs.

Supporting claims
- The company builds Somebody as an AI manager for one-person companies and lean SMEs. (Source: company/profile.)
- The relaunch goal is to convert one-person-company founders. (Source: launch/context.)
- The current launch signal is low signup conversion, and visitors do not recognise themselves. (Source: launch/context.)
- Somebody is intended to extend what a one-person company can do. (Source: company/profile.)

Audience relevance
The intended audience is one-person-company founders and lean SMEs. This message names one-person-company founders directly instead of addressing generic “businesses,” responding to the diagnosis that visitors do not recognise themselves. It is intended for founders who need to extend what they can do as a one-person company or lean SME. No specific pain point is asserted: the previously assumed pain point, “too many tools,” is not validated by the supplied records.

Requested action
Sign up to try Somebody.

Draft page copy
Headline: An AI manager for one-person-company founders.

Subheadline: Somebody helps one-person companies and lean SMEs extend what they can do.

Body: You are building the company. Somebody is an AI manager designed for one-person-company founders and lean SMEs. If you want to extend what you can do as a one-person company or lean SME, sign up to try Somebody.

Primary CTA: Sign up to try Somebody.

Success measures
- Primary outcome: signup conversion for the launch page, measured against the current low-conversion baseline. The baseline value and success threshold are not supplied and must be set before evaluation.
- Diagnostic outcome: whether one-person-company founders and lean SMEs recognise that the page is for them. Use a defined recognition measure; the instrument, baseline, and threshold are not supplied and must be set before evaluation.
- Review the results by intended audience segment so that recognition and signup conversion are not treated as interchangeable measures.

Failure-mode coverage
- Visitor non-recognition: the headline and supporting copy explicitly name one-person-company founders and lean SMEs rather than generic “businesses.”
- Low signup conversion: the page states a single requested action and repeats the signup CTA. The copy does not claim that conversion improvement has already been demonstrated; it requires measurement against a baseline.

Message-level blocker review
No message-level blocker is identified in the supplied company records. This is a draft for review, not a publication or launch authorization. The unvalidated “too many tools” pain point remains excluded. Publication should remain subject to review of the copy, the measurement definitions, baseline, and threshold.

Source notes
- Company profile: company/profile.
- Launch context and goals: launch/context.

Status
Draft for review; not sent or published.

Recommended test: rewrite and test the headline and supporting copy to explicitly identify one-person-company founders and their relevant job-to-be-done; measure signup conversion and qualitative recognition feedback by audience segment. The intended audience is one-person-company founders and lean SMEs. This message names one-person-company founders directly instead of addressing generic “businesses,” responding to the diagnosis that visitors do not recognise themselves. It is intended for founders who need to extend what they can do as a one-person company or lean SME. Sign up to try Somebody.

- Visitor non-recognition: the headline and supporting copy explicitly name one-person-company founders and lean SMEs rather than generic “businesses.”

The unvalidated “too many tools” pain point remains excluded. Publication should remain subject to review of the copy, the measurement definitions, baseline, and threshold.

levels.statement: The revised product launch messaging is coherent, complete for the controlled launch surface, addresses the diagnosed problems, and has explicit success measures and no known message-level blockers to relaunch.

requirements.mustBeTrue: The existing product launch messaging, relevant launch or audience evidence, and applicable company records are available and sufficiently complete to assess why the current messaging is not working.
requirements.title: Relevant launch evidence is available

requirements.mustBeTrue: The current product launch messaging has a documented, evidence-backed diagnosis covering the material failure modes, affected audience or message elements, supporting evidence, and unresolved uncertainty.
requirements.title: Messaging failure is diagnosed

requirements.mustBeTrue: The product relaunch has a complete revised messaging package for the intended audience, including the core message, supporting claims, audience relevance, and requested action, with material changes linked to the diagnosis.
requirements.title: Improved relaunch messaging is defined

requirements.mustBeTrue: The revised product relaunch messaging is internally consistent, complete for its intended launch surface, demonstrably addresses the diagnosed failure modes, and includes explicit success measures and no known message-level blockers to relaunch.
requirements.title: Relaunch messaging is ready

somebodyNow.detail: Somebody recorded the blocker instead of inventing a way around it.
somebodyNow.headline: Blocked — no executable path right now.

workers.responsibility:
Retrieve the requested facts from company records and record them with their source. Report gaps instead of inferring missing values.
Draft the requested artifact from supplied material only, and leave it for review rather than sending or publishing it.
Research public sources and internal records as needed, update the controlled company artifact with a versioned change, and request any missing resources the application must acquire. Do not invoke providers, authorize spend, or make arbitrary external calls.
Answer the assigned question from public sources and record findings with their provenance. Do not assert anything the sources do not support.
